definitions.title: Center of Mass of a Three-Dimensional Solid
definitions.statement: The center of mass (x_bar, y_bar, z_bar) of a solid D with density delta(x, y, z) is the point of gravitational equilibrium, where M is total mass and M_yz, M_xz, M_xy are first moments about the coordinate planes.
definitions.explanation: First moments: M_yz = iiint x delta dV, M_xz = iiint y delta dV, M_xy = iiint z delta dV.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Represents the mass-weighted average position of the continuous distribution.

definitions.title: Moments of Inertia (Second Moments)
definitions.statement: The moment of inertia I_z measures the rotational inertia of a body about the z-axis. The radius of gyration R_z is the radial distance at which concentrating the entire mass produces the same rotational inertia.
definitions.explanation: Integrates squared perpendicular distance r^2 = x^2 + y^2 from the axis of rotation weighted by mass element dm.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Fundamental in rigid-body rotational dynamics: Kinetic Energy = (1/2) I omega^2.
